verdict.rationale: Snyk Code is documented as a developer-first SAST product that developers run locally via `snyk code test`, in IDEs, and in CI/CD. Its source-to-sink flow visualization shows taint-style dataflow analysis, which is the technique used to find injection-type flaws. Custom DeepCode AI queries also let developers search their code for patterns. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming injection and XSS as detected vulnerability classes, a published SAST rule/language coverage list, and independent hands-on corroboration of detection quality.
